subject: executor,planner: Relax projection column expression push down check conditions (#52502)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent focusing on `pkg/expression` + `pkg/planner/core`. Change introduces `expression.ProjectionExpressionsToPBList` and switches `PhysicalProjection.ToPB` to use it, allowing top-level `Column` refs in pushed-down projections to skip type-gating (since no computation is performed). Also removes the MPP-only `prunePhysicalColumns` post-opt pass. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantic, consistency, compatibility, concurrency, privilege, or session/runtime-handling issues found in the touched planner/expression behavior.
